description: Unique recipient observations exposed across the exploratory development replay and its scoring bank, now informing method development. Separate fixed development resource, not independent biological replication or free final-test validation.
limitations: Fixed development costs must be disclosed alongside incremental recipient budgets; source data and computation are separate resources. This is not a claim that all counterfactual policies could simultaneously buy the same physical cells.
policy_specific_counterfactual_costs: Separate ledgers charge each simulated policy afresh; union accounting here counts shared retrospective development observations once.
